title: App Icon — Minimal Waveform Halo (icon only)
prompt: Minimal premium app icon for a voice-first African fintech. NO text. A luminous circular halo formed from a single smooth voice waveform that curves around into a closed orbit, set on a soft pearl-white background (#DDE8ED) inside a rounded-square icon. At the exact center, a small glowing neon-mint pulse (#69CEA9) marks a completed payment. The halo ring is electric cyan (#70D0E0) fading to soft aqua (#A9D3DF), with one delicate warm-gold glint (#F4DFA0) at the top of the ring. Lots of clean negative space, strong simple silhouette that reads at tiny sizes, glassy soft reflections, Apple-grade polish, app-store ready.
negative_prompt: text, wordmark, currency particles, dollar signs, coins, microphone, arrows, clutter, dark background, busy detail, harsh neon, low-res, multiple icons

brand_lock.one_idea: waveform that becomes a halo orbit + mint center pulse

notes: Decluttered 'Voice Wave Transaction Halo'. The cleanest, most iconic option — likely best as the actual app/favicon. Export to all PWA sizes once approved.
